Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/Marrickville/Marrickville DCP 2011 - 2 9 Community Safety.pdf

Clause None - other (development_control): Assessing all applications against bas ic CPTED design principles; and  
2. Undertaking a crime risk assessment for specifically identified development types.

Clause None - other (development_control): This section of the DCP  sets out detailed objectives and controls for CPTED against 
which Council will assess all de velopments. In addition, this section stipulates the 
development types that will be subject to a formal crime risk assessme nt process 
under Section 2.9.5.

Clause None - other (development_control): To ensure all development applications are assessed against the four core CPTED principles to enhanc e community safety.

Clause None - other (development_control): To encourage  development which adjoins laneways, alleyways, parks 
and open spaces or other public areas to contribute to the safety of 
those areas by maximising opportunities for surveillance.

Clause None - other (development_control): To encourage the use of external lighting to improve the safety and 
security of property by increasing opportunities for casual surveillance 
and deterring illegal access.

Clause None - other (development_control): To minimise unintended or unauthorised access to any premises by the appropriate design and location of built and natural elements.

Clause None - other (development_control): Access control uses  physical and symbolic barriers to attract, channel or restrict the 
movement of people in order to make it clear where people are permitted to go or not 
go.
